items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: There's another boy, Italian boy, he used to sing like, he used to sing like this fella, yeah. Oh, man, dead now. He used to blacken his face all the time. Al Jones. Al Jones. But you know what, dude, that fella could sing like that, don't you? He really could imitate him.

ctx.x: Just like legends, they used to do that, they have to sing.

Yes, yes, some of them couldn't sing, no ha, you know what I mean? But I just, you know what I mean, just to keep them making hard feelings, you know what I mean? I let them sing, let them do what they could, you know what I mean? The best they could. So, well, well, you know, satisfied them, you know what I mean? Make them happy, you see? Make them happy, you see? Make them happy. So, they couldn't, they couldn't ever say, I was a fella who was disagreeable, you know what I mean? Just what they say, I was…
